arguments.reasoning:
Rows: retained baseline cf997605 (holding_max_error_m 0.05814, holding_max_speed_m_s 1.5810, terminal_error_m 0.00764, both holding checks false); immediate predecessor 50618bf2 (holding_max_error_m 0.00828 pass, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.03557 fail, terminal_error_m 0.00819 pass, joint false); completed candidate batch-bc1f58ac54026d97-0 / execution 44dbf3bc (change control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight -> 0.1; holding_max_error_m 0.00833 pass, holding_max_speed_m_s 0.04868 fail, terminal_error_m 0.00812 pass, joint false).

Hypothesis status: weakened. The predicted further reduction of sampled final-window holding maximum world-tip speed did not occur: against the immediate predecessor the candidate raised holding_max_speed_m_s by +0.01311 (0.03557 -> 0.04868), i.e. away from the 0.02 criterion, while holding_max_error_m rose +5.53e-05 and terminal_error_m fell -6.34e-05. Reach retention is supported (terminal_error_m 0.00812 <= 0.01, terminal_reach_passed true). Acceptance is not reached: holding_speed_passed false, joint_reach_holding_passed false; only the holding-position component passes. Against the retained baseline the candidate is a large physical trade-off (holding_max_error_m -0.04981, holding_max_speed_m_s -1.532, terminal_error_m +0.00048): improvements and a slight worsening coexist, classified physical_tradeoff both ways, so no overall improvement and raw scalar objectives were not ranked.

Scope: one tested point on one value. It neither identifies a dominant cause of the reach/holding outcome nor shows ineffectiveness across a parameter range. A small position error does not certify holding-speed prediction, and late-horizon shortening alone identifies no cause. Continuous-time, real-time and hardware behaviour remain untested.

Disposition: reject the recommendation as stated at this tested point; the configuration is not adopted. Retain the retained baseline as the standing reference because no candidate reached joint acceptance. The tested change is not selected.
